environment.description: Same Flask application packaged as a container image and deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has no additional policies beyond basic CloudWatch Logs permissions. The function URL resource policy does not include a wildcard principal - it specifies only the internal service account ARN (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InternalDocServiceRole) as the allowed invoker. There is no API Gateway or ALB in front. The Lambda runtime uses a read-only root filesystem with only /tmp writable, and each invocation gets an isolated /tmp (cleared between cold starts but potentially shared across warm invocations within the same execution environment). The container runs as uid 993 (sbx_user1091).

config.runtime: AWS Lambda container image, python3.11 managed runtime
config.filesystem: /tmp only writable, 512MB ephemeral, isolated per execution environment
config.tmp_behavior: single-process per invocation, no concurrent access to /tmp within same request
